title: Concepts of Tarbiyah in Islam and the Rulings Concerning the Child

text_simplified: This text addresses the topic of tarbiyah (Islamic upbringing) in Islam, explaining its concepts, objectives, and methods. It clarifies the importance of raising children upon akhlaq (moral character) and Islamic values, as well as the role of the masjid and the school in this regard. It also covers the rulings concerning the child in Islam, such as lineage, breastfeeding, and custody. Additionally, it offers guidance to parents on how to raise children with a balanced tarbiyah that combines firmness and tenderness.
